title: Your own syscalls
question: Make any syscall, with the arguments you give, written as in C: the program makes it, recorded. Numbers (0644, 0x41, -100), the kernel's constants (O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, AT_FDCWD), "strings", {0, 30000000} (a struct, laid out as the parameter's type says); results by name (int fd = openat(…), then fd); and variables of your program's, declared as in C (char buf[64], int fds[2], struct __kernel_timespec ts = {0, 30000000}), for the kernel to fill or read: read(fd, buf, 64), &ts, fds[1].
text: You have seen the lessons; now make any syscall, with the arguments you give, written as in C.
